A Happy Marriage Is Worth Fighting For

幸福的婚姻需要用心经营 · 210 词 · 4 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1As a talented officer in the navy, he was bound to be busy. When his wife rang him up to say that she wanted a divorce, he was still scanning a digital counter to check the data for an assessment of the theoretical framework for a biochemical weapon. The sympathy of his junior colleagues embarrassed him.

2His wife was a part-time clerk. Thanks to his generous bonus, she lived in a grand house with elegant cushions and bedding. Her favourite pastime was sitting in her armchair, reading celebrities’ biographies or works of absurd fiction with seemingly endless chapters. People envied her life of leisure. But in fact, she was tired of being left alone. Every week she emailed him to state how she felt and ask him to spend more time with her, but she never got a satisfactory reply. Tired of hearing that he had to obey orders, she filed for divorce.

3Hoping to rekindle their affection for each other, he set other affairs aside. He trimmed his fingernails, lost weight and got a better haircut. He wore an apron to prepare delicious cuisine for her. He also bought her a necklace and bunches of flowers, hoping to win her back.

4After three months of trying, he finally succeeded.

幸福的婚姻需要用心经营

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1他是个才干出众的海军军官，工作自然繁忙。妻子打电话来说想离婚时，他还盯着数字计数器核对数据，准备评估一种生化武器的理论框架。下属对他的同情让他觉得很尴尬。

2妻子做的是兼职文员。靠着丈夫丰厚的奖金，她住在气派的大房子里，坐垫和床上用品都很讲究。她最喜欢坐在扶手椅里读明星传记，或翻看章节多得读不完的荒诞小说。别人都羡慕她的悠闲日子，其实她已经厌倦了独处。她每周都发邮件说出心里的想法，请丈夫多陪陪她，却从来没收到让她满意的答复。丈夫总说自己必须服从命令，她听够了，终于提出离婚。

3他想挽回两人珍贵的感情，便把别的事先放到一边。他剪短指甲，减了体重，也换掉了难看的发型。他系上围裙，给妻子做可口的饭菜，还买来一条项链和许多鲜花，希望她能回心转意。

4经过整整三个月的考验，他终于挽回了这段感情。
